csv_project_name: DB for DMAFB Communications Headquarters Facility

csv_scope_of_work: Design build services for construct a 45,025SF Communications Squadron headquarters facility with reinforced concrete foundation, concrete slab, structural steel frame, standing seam metal roof and exterior. The project will include all supporting facilities such as site improvements, utilities, communications, pavements, parking, and sidewalks necessary to provide a complete and useable facility.
